manual_sections.title: 2. Motor overload
manual_sections.text:
2. Motor overload
The simulated drive label MOTOR_OVERLOAD means motor protection detected excessive loading
over time. The label does not identify a unique failed component. Possible explanations include
mechanical resistance or obstruction, motor-related problems, or incorrect motor configuration. A
recent product change is context, not proof of cause.

SENSOR_BLOCKED means the carton detector's detection signal remained active longer than the configured interval. It does not establish that the detector has failed. manual_sections.title: Detection timeout
manual_sections.text:
Detection timeout
SENSOR_BLOCKED means the carton detector's detection signal remained active longer than the configured interval. It does not establish that the detector has failed. Possible explanations include a carton obstructing the beam, contamination on the optical surface, or detector alignment. This is a detection condition, not a drive overload report.

manual_sections.title: 2. Motor overload
manual_sections.text:
2. Motor overload
The simulated drive label MOTOR_OVERLOAD means motor protection detected excessive loading
over time. The label does not identify a unique failed component. Possible explanations include
mechanical resistance or obstruction, motor-related problems, or incorrect motor configuration. A
recent product change is context, not proof of cause.

manual_sections.title: Detection timeout
manual_sections.text:
Detection timeout
SENSOR_BLOCKED means the carton detector's detection signal remained active longer than the configured interval. It does not establish that the detector has failed. Possible explanations include a carton obstructing the beam, contamination on the optical surface, or detector alignment. This is a detection condition, not a drive overload report.
